title: Wendy's Nearly Round Biscuit
synopsis: Wendy and Aunt Kay make funny Moon-shaped biscuits in Far Meadow while a waxing gibbous Moon appears over the Windbreak Tree.
continuity_state: Before: Kim saw a first-quarter Moon from Round Pond. Wendy lives with Aunt Kay in cream Far Meadow cottage west of Bell Hill; her straw hat has the original blue ribbon and their picnic banner remains in the inside window. After: Some evenings after first quarter, a waxing gibbous Moon is visible near dusk. Aunt Kay bakes biscuits with Wendy, who chooses crooked Moon, slipper and potato shapes. Some biscuits remain at the cottage for tomorrow; no snack delivery or inter-meadow travel occurs at night. Hat ribbon and banner remain unchanged.

related_resources.reason: NASA defines waxing gibbous appearance as more than half of the Moon's visible disk illuminated, progressing toward full.
The child treats biscuits as imaginary characters. AAP guidance concerns play broadly and does not measure benefits from this audio episode.
